registry_checks: No Dockery/slowest-diffuser aliases Palomar/Hexagon/OpenAI metadata. Focused arXiv, Zenodo, HAL, GitHub and primary author/publisher searches.
scope_comparison: Need every N>=3 and ordered finite positive rates in a fixed nonconstant nonnegative resource environment. High-rate threshold, existence of open configurations and N=2 theorem do not cover arbitrary rates. Time-dependent environment counterexamples violate fixed-environment premise.
rationale: Bounded searches found no full matching resolution or announcement. Exact primary theorem retains high-diffusion restriction.
